text.paragraph: Liver warning: These products contain acetaminophen. Severe liver damage may occur if you take:

list.item: more than 4,000 mg of acetaminophen in 24 hours
with other drugs containing acetaminophen
3 or more alcoholic drinks every day while using these products

text.paragraph: Allergy alert: Acetaminophen may cause severe skin reactions. Symptoms may include:

list.item: skin reddening
blisters
rash

text.paragraph: If a skin reaction occurs, stop use and seek medical help right away
Sore throat warning: If sore throat is severe, persists for more than 2 days, is accompanied or followed by fever, headache, rash, nausea, or vomiting, consult a doctor promptly.

text.paragraph: Overdose warning: Taking more than the recommended dose can cause liver damage. In case of overdose, get medical help or contact a Poison Control Center (1-800-222-1222) right away. Quick medical attention is critical for adults as well as for children even if you do not notice any signs or symptoms.
